nodes.line: You are not from around the corner, are you.

The council knows and the council does not care. I am sending back 84 papers a day from Wiley Park and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Ask for me by name at the counter.

I have been putting it off since Easter. They will drop my Wiley Park order if I can show $45 of turnover on the other side of the shop by grand final week. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Come back and tell me straight.
Take a breath. Then say the whole thing.

nodes.line: Half of this suburb has walked past already. Not one stopped.

Before you say anything: yes, I know. I do the Wiley Park round from half six and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Do that and we're square.

It is not a police matter and I have checked. There is a dog on the Wiley Park round that has had two of my bags and two hundred metres of orange netting that was not even mine. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I will owe you one, and I pay those.
Go on then. What did you find.
